# Veyro

> Veyro is a Mac app that changes the artwork of credit, debit and transit cards in Apple Wallet on your iPhone. Choose from a gallery of designs or upload your own image. Payments, card numbers and balances stay exactly the same.

Website: https://veyro.biz
Contact: hello@veyro.biz
Platform: macOS 14 Sonoma or later (Apple silicon and Intel). Works with an iPhone on iOS 17 or later, connected by USB cable or Wi-Fi sync.
Jailbreak required: No
Account required: No
Data sent to servers by the app: None. Veyro runs entirely on the Mac. The website counts Download clicks (time, IP, user-agent) and page views (Cloudflare Web Analytics, cookieless).

## What Veyro does

- Mirrors the cards in Apple Wallet on a connected iPhone and shows which can be restyled.
- Lets the user drag a design from a built-in gallery, or drop their own PNG or JPG, onto a card.
- Writes the new card artwork to the iPhone. The restyled card appears in Wallet and at payment time.
- Keeps the original artwork of every card. Each card has undo, and the whole wallet can be rewound to its first-connection state.
- Changes only the image shown on the card. Apple Pay, card numbers, expiry dates, balances and bank connections are untouched.

## Pricing

- Free during early access: unlimited uploads, full gallery, undo, no account.
- No payment system yet. Paid plans, if any, will be announced on the site first.
